title: UDAAN - Flagship event of the Regal year
summary: Udaan, a flagship event of the Rotary Club of Mumbai Juhu; the 22nd Interact District Conference was held at Deenanath Mangeshkar Auditorium, Vile Parle East on Friday, 09.10.26.
description: Udaan, a flagship event of the Rotary Club of Mumbai Juhu; the 22nd Interact District Conference was held at Deenanath Mangeshkar Auditorium, Vile Parle East on Friday, 09.10.26. Rotary club of Addiction Prevention was the Platinum Host for this event. The programme commenced with an inauguration by Captain Amandeep Kapur and educationist Dr Priya Rajwade , Guests of Honour, who lit the ceremonial lamp. Captain Amandeep Kapur inspired the interactors through his Army Journey while Rtn. Nilesh Samant of RC Bombay West motivated students with lessons from the life of Sachin Tendulkar. The Nasha Mukt Bharat campaign was highlighted through competitions followed by a pledge to remain free from addiction. The Udaan 2026 Regal Year Competitions included PPT presentations of nearly 200 participants which was judged by eminent artists. The event witnessed participation from 40 Rotarians, 500 Interactors, 50 Rotaractors, making Udaan a true celebration of youth leadership and service.
